senses.sense_definition: A person who unlawfully makes, transports, or sells goods, especially alcoholic liquor.

examples.text: During Prohibition, a notorious <w>bootlegger</w> supplied secret bars with illegal whiskey.
The local <w>bootleggers</w> used fast cars to outrun the police on country roads.

senses.sense_definition: A person who unlawfully reproduces, distributes, or sells copyrighted material, such as music or films.

examples.text: The band hired security guards to catch any <w>bootlegger</w> recording the live concert.
Police arrested a <w>bootlegger</w> who was selling unreleased studio tracks online.

senses.sense_definition: A person who extracts coal or minerals unlawfully, typically from an abandoned or unpermitted mine.

examples.text: The company hired guards to prevent any <w>bootlegger</w> from digging on company land.
During the strike, an impoverished <w>bootlegger</w> mined coal from closed pits to survive.
